name: mixtools
description: Mix and master songs in Ardour with Claude: import tracks, change levels, pans, effects and sends, bounce, measure, compare before and after, and render release-ready masters for streaming.
long_description: Mixtools lets Claude act as a mix engineer for someone who is not an audio engineer. It drives Ardour through Ardour's built-in MCP server, renders bounces with Ardour's command-line exporter, and measures them (loudness, peaks, stereo, frequency balance) so Claude can explain what it hears in numbers and check every change. It sets a starting balance on newly imported tracks. It marks notes the person gives at a moment in the song and finds which track gets buried or jumps out there. It masters finished mixes for streaming with a true-peak limiter and checks masters against distributor and streaming targets. It makes alternate versions (instrumental, TV mix, a cappella, clean edit, stems) that match a master exactly, and archives finished songs. It keeps mix notes for each song, so a new conversation picks up where the last one stopped. Requires the Ardour build distributed with mixtools.

tools.name: mixtools_status
tools.description: Check Ardour, its MCP server, the open song, and the workspace folders.

tools.name: mixtools_setup
tools.description: Create the workspace folders and turn on Ardour's MCP server.

tools.name: song_new
tools.description: Create a song in Ardour and import audio files as tracks.

tools.name: song_open
tools.description: Open a song in Ardour, or list songs.

tools.name: ardour_tools
tools.description: List Ardour's own MCP tools.

tools.name: ardour_call
tools.description: Call one of Ardour's MCP tools.

tools.name: snapshot_save
tools.description: Save the mixer settings so they can be restored.

tools.name: snapshot_list
tools.description: List mixer snapshots.

tools.name: snapshot_restore
tools.description: Restore a mixer snapshot.

tools.name: bounce
tools.description: Render the mix, and optionally single tracks, to WAV.

tools.name: audio_measure
tools.description: Measure loudness, peaks, stereo, and frequency balance.

tools.name: audio_compare
tools.description: Compare two audio files and describe the differences.

tools.name: audio_spectrogram
tools.description: Draw a spectrogram image of an audio file.

tools.name: audio_play
tools.description: Play an audio file, at matched loudness or as a streaming service would, optionally as heard on a phone, in a car, or in mono.

tools.name: audio_stop
tools.description: Stop playback.

tools.name: master_render
tools.description: Master a mix bounce for streaming: loudness, true-peak limiting, trim, fade, dither.

tools.name: release_check
tools.description: Check whether a master is ready to upload for streaming release.

tools.name: vocal_sibilance
tools.description: Find a vocal's s sounds and predict what the Mixtools De-Esser does to each.

tools.name: master_versions
tools.description: Make an instrumental, TV mix, a cappella, clean edit, or stems that match an approved master exactly.

tools.name: song_archive
tools.description: Zip a song's session, recordings, masters, versions, and mix notes for backup or handoff.

tools.name: mix_starting_balance
tools.description: Set first-pass faders on a new song so no track starts buried or clipping.

tools.name: moment_mark
tools.description: Mark a note the person gives at a time in the song with an Ardour marker, and log it.

tools.name: moment_check
tools.description: Measure one moment of a bounce: which track gets buried or jumps out there, and the phrase around it.

tools.name: journal_read
tools.description: Read a song's mix notes so a new conversation can pick up where the last one stopped.

tools.name: journal_write
tools.description: Add to a song's mix notes: a log line, or the person's goals and preferences.

tools.name: reference_list
tools.description: List reference songs and their loudness.
